news.title: Augustana School of Music to Bear Names of Longtime Supporters, Alumni
news.summary_en: Augustana University announced the naming of its School of Music — thanks to the ongoing support of Augustana alumni Dr. Greg ‘74 and Karen (Devick) Schultz ‘75. Along with the Augustana Choir, the Augustana community celebrated theKaren and Greg Schultz School of Music(SSOM) with a dedication ceremony in Hamre Recital Hall — located in the Fryxell Humanities Center where the newly-named school is
